title: HiNT-Surv: Hierarchical Niche-Aware Multimodal Survival Prediction from Imaging Mass Cytometry, Clinicopathologic Variables, and Genomic Data
citation: IEEE Symposium on Computational Intelligence in Health and Medicine (CIHM), IEEE SSCI 2027.
summary: Models tissue niches hierarchically from imaging mass cytometry and fuses them with clinicopathologic variables and genomic data to predict breast cancer survival.

title: A Deep Learning Model Supporting Classification and Localisation of Breast Tumour Lesions on Ultrasound
citation: Journal of Medical Research (Hanoi Medical University), 2026. Article in Vietnamese.
summary: A deep learning model that supports the classification of breast tumour lesions on ultrasound images and localises each lesion within the image.

title: A Multimodal Deep Learning Framework for Breast Cancer Receptor Status Prediction
citation: IUKM 2026, LNAI 16918, Part I, Springer, pp. 102–114, 2027.
summary: Fuses clinical variables, H&E whole-slide images, and tumour RNA-seq with modality-level self-attention to predict ER, PR, and HER2 status jointly in breast cancer.

title: Development and Cross-Cohort Evaluation of a Multimodal Deep-Learning Model for ER, PR and HER2 Status Classification in Breast Cancer
summary: A journal study related to [C3] that develops a multimodal deep-learning model for ER, PR, and HER2 status classification and evaluates it across independent cohorts.

title: H2F-GCN: Skeleton-based Hypergraph Frequency Coordinate Fusion Graph Convolution Network for Physical Rehabilitation Assessment
summary: A skeleton-based graph convolution network that fuses hypergraph, frequency, and coordinate information for physical rehabilitation assessment.
